prompt: Documentary photograph of a tall, neat stack of printed A4 quarterly construction progress reports on a plain pale wooden desk beside a window in a Gurugram office, India. Each report is held by a single black bulldog clip and squared up on the one below, so the stack reads like the floor slabs of a building under construction; the top two reports sit slightly offset, as if just filed. A yellow pencil and a pair of reading glasses rest beside the stack. Soft morning daylight from the left, shallow depth of field, calm and matter-of-fact. All printed text soft and illegible. No logos, no names, no letterheads, no seals, no readable words. Portrait crop with the stack filling the centre two thirds and quiet space above it. Used as the hero picture of Plinth's 'How Delivery Risk works' page.
